# Customer.io — Style Reference

> Teal ink pressed into white stock, with a green halo around one button. One custom grotesk held at weight 475, a pure white canvas, 1px mist-gray hairlines and a 4px sprout-green ring mark the single place to click.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

This is a single-weight teal-ink language. A white `#ffffff` canvas carries nearly everything. A `#f5f5f5` fog band handles quiet strips, `#0b363b` spruce is the only inverted surface (announcement bar, primary CTA, photo scrims), and `#00262b` replaces black as the primary ink. The chromatic budget is three small hues: a `#b6f2a3` sprout ring that exists only around the primary button, `#a87a12` ochre for micro-markers and case-study tags, and `#3f9a4a` moss for trust checkmarks. None of them may fill anything larger than a tag. Typography is one face, Saans, pinned at an off-grid weight of 475 (125 of 180 sampled elements). It runs from 12px captions to 96px display with a flat 0.2px tracking, so size alone carries hierarchy along a Major Third ladder up to 40px. Shapes split into 9999px pills for actions and 0–6px everywhere else. Elevation is a ring, not a shadow. The page reads as a printed annual report rather than a SaaS landing page.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page body, nav bar, feature columns, secondary button fill — the white stock that every hairline and teal stroke is printed onto. |
| Fog Surface | `#f5f5f5` | `--color-fog-surface` | Trust-line strip inside the logo grid, secondary button halo ring, quiet bands — the only tonal step, so separation stays almost invisible. |
| Cream Tag | `#fbf3e0` | `--color-cream-tag` | "case study" tag fill in logo cells, estimated from screenshot — a warm paper chip that pairs with ochre text. Do not use it as a section background. |
| Spruce Fill | `#0b363b` | `--color-spruce-fill` | Primary CTA fill, announcement bar, chat send button, secondary button border — the brand's one saturated-dark mass, used as punctuation rather than decoration. |
| Spruce Scrim | `#0b363bcc` | `--color-spruce-scrim` | Overlay on the five capability photo tiles, estimated at 80% opacity — turns photography into a monochrome teal field so white labels stay legible. |
| Lagoon Ink | `#00262b` | `--color-lagoon-ink` | H1 through H3, nav labels, body copy, arrow links — a teal-black that reads as black at a glance while keeping the brand hue in every glyph. |
| Slate Caption | `#4d6164` | `--color-slate-caption` | Feature column descriptions, AI Agent paragraph, supporting body, estimated — the secondary text tier, cooled toward teal rather than neutral gray. |
| Pewter Meta | `#7a898b` | `--color-pewter-meta` | Trust microcopy beside checkmarks, small metadata, estimated — the tertiary text tier. Never use it for paragraphs longer than one line. |
| Mist Border | `#e5e8e8` | `--color-mist-border` | Nav bottom rule, logo grid cell walls, feature column dividers, 1px borders on 16 elements, estimated — the line work that replaces cards. |
| Sprout Halo | `#b6f2a3` | `--color-sprout-halo` | 4px ring around the primary "Get started" pill, converted from oklch(0.9263 0.136 145.2) — the signature focus glow. Do not promote it to a fill color. |
| Ochre Marker | `#a87a12` | `--color-ochre-marker` | Eyebrow tag glyph, feature column icons, case-study tag text, estimated — a gold accent rationed to icons 16px and smaller. |
| Moss Check | `#3f9a4a` | `--color-moss-check` | Checkmark glyphs in the hero trust row and "Running" status dots, estimated — status-only green. Do not use it for buttons or links. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Saans — one variable grotesk carrying display, UI and micro-labels at a single dominant weight · `--font-saans`

- **Substitute:** Geist at 475, Inter at 500, Hanken Grotesk at 500. Saans draws slightly wider and heavier than its nominal 475, so the rendered stroke sits closer to a conventional medium. Inter and Hanken need the step up to 500 to match, while Geist's variable axis can take 475 directly.
- **Weights:** 475, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 10px, 12px, 14px, 16px, 18px, 20px, 24px, 30px, 40px, 64px, 96px
- **Line height:** 1.0 (64–96px), 1.125 (20–40px headings), 1.375 (10–20px text)
- **Letter spacing:** 0.2px at every size from 10px to 96px. Nav menu buttons at 16px use normal.
- **Role:** Weight 475 is the signature. It sits deliberately between regular and medium, so 96px headlines feel solid without shouting and 14px body feels firm without going bold. Accounting for 125 of 180 measured elements, it is the workhorse, and 600 is reserved for nav, H3s and buttons. The 16 → 20 → 24 → 30 → 40 ladder is a near-exact Major Third (1.25). It then leaps 1.6× to 64px and 1.5× to 96px, which separates display from everything else. The constant 0.2px tracking is anti-convention: most display type tightens 2–3% at 96px, and here the headline keeps its text-size spacing, which reads as editorial calm rather than marketing compression.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Saans | 500 | 10px | 1.375 | 0.2px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Saans | 475 | 12px | 1.375 | 0.2px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Saans | 475 | 14px | 1.375 | 0.2px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Saans | 475 | 16px | 1.375 | 0.2px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Saans | 475 | 20px | 1.375 | 0.2px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Saans | 600 | 20px | 1.125 | 0.2px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Saans | 475 | 24px | 1.125 | 0.2px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Saans | 475 | 40px | 1.125 | 0.2px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Saans | 475 | 64px | 1.0 | 0.2px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Saans | 475 | 96px | 1.0 | 0.2px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline from 24px to 96px at weight 475 — the restrained weight is the signature, and size does the hierarchy work.
- Keep tracking at 0.2px across all sizes, including 96px display — flat tracking preserves the editorial calm that negative tracking would turn into ad copy.
- Use `#00262b` for all primary text and `#0b363b` for all dark fills — the teal-black keeps brand hue inside every glyph without adding a color.
- Shape every button as a 9999px pill with a 2px border and 8px 20px padding — the capsule is reserved for actions, so it is instantly recognizable.
- Separate content with 1px `#e5e8e8` hairlines at 0px radius — ruled columns and cells replace cards and keep the grid architectural.
- Ration `#b6f2a3` to the single 4px ring around the primary CTA — one glow per viewport is non-negotiable, because it is the page's only wayfinding beacon.
- Space sections 128px apart inside a 1320px container — the generous gap lets 40px headings breathe at a weight that does not shout.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 700 for "impact" — weight 700 appears on 3 elements total, and pushing H1s or H2s there destroys the single-weight thesis that defines the system.
- Don't apply -2% tracking to the 96px display — tightening is the conventional move, and here it erases the deliberate text-like spacing of the headline.
- Don't use `#000000` or neutral grays like `#333333` for text — they break the teal undertone carried by `#00262b` and `#4d6164`.
- Don't wrap features in rounded 12px cards with drop shadows — the system uses 0px radius and 1px `#e5e8e8` rules, and floating cards turn the report into a dashboard.
- Don't fill buttons or banners with `#b6f2a3` or `#3f9a4a` — green exists only as a 4px ring and as status glyphs, and a green fill steals the CTA's meaning.
- Don't round tags to 9999px — the 2px tag radius distinguishes metadata from actions, and pill tags read as clickable buttons.
- Never color running text with the six decorative statement hues — that treatment is a one-sentence editorial exception, and repeating it collapses the three-hue budget.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f5f5f5 (Fog Surface)
- primary text: #00262b (Lagoon Ink)
- secondary text: #4d6164 (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #e5e8e8 (Mist Border)
- accent marker: #a87a12 (Ochre Marker)
- focus halo: #b6f2a3 (Sprout Halo)
- primary action: #0b363b (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use solid `#0b363b` for the primary series and `#0b363b` at 30% opacity for comparisons, with `#3f9a4a` reserved for a single positive-status line. Gridlines are 1px `#e5e8e8`, so no data color ever outshouts the primary pill.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Primary Action Button: build an anchor styled as a pill with background `#0b363b`, text `#ffffff`, border 2px solid `#0b363b`, border-radius 9999px, padding 8px 20px and height 40px. Set the font to Saans (fallback Geist at 475, Inter at 500) at 14px, weight 600, line-height 1.375, letter-spacing 0.2px. Apply box-shadow `0px 0px 0px 4px #b6f2a3`. On hover keep the geometry and shift the background to `#00262b`. Place a matching secondary button 8px to its right with background `#ffffff`, text `#00262b`, the same 2px `#0b363b` border, and box-shadow `0px 0px 0px 4px #f5f5f5`.

2. Hero Section: on `#ffffff`, inside a 1320px container with 32px side padding and 96px top padding, left-align an H1 in Saans 96px, weight 475, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 0.2px, color `#00262b`, over two lines. Add 32px gap, then a 20px weight 475 subline at line-height 1.375 in `#00262b`, max-width 500px. Add 32px gap, then the primary and secondary pills from prompt 1. Add 16px gap, then a row of three trust items, each a `#3f9a4a` 10px check icon plus 10px weight 500 text in `#7a898b`, spaced 12px apart. Below, after 64px, place a 1256px-wide product screenshot with 6px top-left and top-right radius, no shadow.

3. Navigation Bar: create a sticky header 64px tall with background `#ffffff`, a 1px solid `#e5e8e8` bottom border and 0px radius, inside a 1680px max-width with 64px side padding. Put the wordmark (152px wide, `#0b363b`) left. Center four menu buttons (Platform, Solutions, Resources with 12px chevrons, Pricing) in Saans 16px weight 600, normal letter-spacing, `#00262b`, padding 0 8px 0 16px, full 64px height. On the right place a "Sign in" text link at 14px weight 600 with 8px padding, then the primary and secondary 40px pills 8px apart. Above it add a 32px `#0b363b` announcement bar with centered 14px weight 475 `#ffffff` text.

4. Feature Column Row: in a 1256px container, lay out three equal columns with no background, each with a 1px solid `#e5e8e8` left border, 0px radius and padding 0 24px. In each column stack a 16px line icon in `#a87a12`, then a 24px gap, an H3 in Saans 16px weight 600 line-height 1.375 color `#00262b`, then a 4px gap and a 16px weight 475 paragraph in `#4d6164`. No shadows, no card fills.

5. Capability Photo Tiles: build a 1680px-wide row of five equal tiles, 333px tall, 0px radius, separated by 1px `#0b363b` seams. Each tile holds a cover-fit team photograph under an overlay of `#0b363bcc`. Place a 32px circular button 16px from the top and left edges with a `#0b363bcc` fill and a 16px `#ffffff` plus glyph. Set the label 16px from the bottom and left in Saans 20px weight 600, line-height 1.125, `#ffffff`.

## Tokens — Spacing & Shapes

**Density:** spacious

### Spacing Scale

| 4 | 4px | `--spacing-4` |
| 6 | 6px | `--spacing-6` |

### Border Radius

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| buttons | 9999px |
| pills | 9999px |
| tags | 2px |
| badges | 2px |
| smallElements | 2px |

| images | 6px (top corners only) |
| cards | 0px |

| Name | Value | Token |
|---|---|---|
| sm | `0px 0px 0px 4px #b6f2a3` | `--shadow-sm` |
| sm-2 | `0px 0px 0px 4px #f5f5f5` | `--shadow-sm-2` |

### Layout

- **Page max-width:** 1320px (1320–1680px outer bleed)
- **Section gap:** 128px (96–160px)
- **Card padding:** 24px (16–32px)
- **Element gap:** 24px (8–32px)

## Components

### Pill Button — Spruce (Primary)

**Role:** The one conversion action per view

A dark capsule with a glow. It uses a `#0b363b` background, `#ffffff` text, a 2px solid `#0b363b` border, 9999px radius, 8px 20px padding and 40px height. The label is Saans 14px at 600 with 0.2px tracking, and the shadow is `0px 0px 0px 4px #b6f2a3`. The green ring is the system's only use of a hue around an interactive element. It marks "Get started" as the destination in both nav and hero, so do not repeat it on a second button in the same viewport.

### Pill Button — Outline (Secondary)

**Role:** The alternate, lower-commitment action

The same capsule, inverted. It uses a `#ffffff` background, `#00262b` text, a 2px solid `#0b363b` border, 9999px radius, 8px 20px padding and 40px height. The label is Saans 14px at 600, and the shadow is `0px 0px 0px 4px #f5f5f5`. It keeps the exact geometry of the primary, so the pair reads as one decision with two weights. The fog-gray ring is a deliberate echo of the green one, present but tonally silent. It carries "Book a demo".

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Sticky white header with centered menu

A flat white rail. It is sticky, 64px tall, with a `#ffffff` background, a 1px `#e5e8e8` bottom rule and 0px radius. The 152px wordmark sits left. Centered menu buttons (Platform, Solutions, Resources with chevrons, then Pricing) are set in Saans 16px at 600 with normal tracking, `#00262b`, and 0px 8px 0px 16px padding at full 64px height. Right-aligned are a ghost "Sign in" (14px at 600, 8px padding) and both pills, with no shadow. The bar trusts weight 600 and position rather than color, unlike the conventional tinted SaaS header.

### Announcement Bar

**Role:** Inverted release note above nav

A thin spruce ribbon. It uses a `#0b363b` background, 32px height and 0px radius, with centered Saans 14px at 475 in `#ffffff`. A date, a 1px divider and a trailing arrow sit on one line with 12px gaps. It is the page's only full-width dark band above the fold, and it signals freshness without introducing a new color.

### Display Headline — Rotating Channel Word

**Role:** Hero statement with animated noun

The quiet giant. The headline is Saans 96px at 475, line height 1.0, 0.2px tracking, `#00262b`, no background, measured at 1256px wide over two lines. The final word cycles through channels (SMS, message), assembling letter by letter. Pair it with a 20px at 475 subline in `#00262b`, kept to 501px wide, and a 32px gap to the button pair. Weight 475 at this size is the thesis made visible: massive, unforced and untightened.

### Trust Check Row

**Role:** Risk-reversal microcopy under CTAs

Three tiny guarantees. Each is a 10px `#3f9a4a` checkmark circle followed by Saans 10px at 500 in `#7a898b`. Items sit 12px apart, and the row sits 16px below the buttons. This is the only place the small role appears, and it keeps "14-day free trial" factual rather than promotional.

### Product Screenshot Stage

**Role:** Product UI composited over photography

A window in a room. A full-width product screenshot (1256×707 container, inner UI image 1096×617) sits over a softly lit interior photograph. It has a 6px 6px 0px 0px radius, no border and no shadow, and bleeds off its bottom edge into the logo grid. The chart blue inside the mockup is mockup-internal, not a system token. Rounding only the top corners makes the UI feel like it rises out of the page rather than floating above it.

### Logo Grid — Hairline Cells

**Role:** Customer proof in ruled cells

A ledger of brands. It has two rows of four cells on `#ffffff`, each walled by 1px `#e5e8e8` borders at 0px radius, with monochrome logos (86–96px wide) centered in 48px-tall cells. A middle strip on `#f5f5f5` carries Saans 14px at 475 in `#00262b` with "11,000+ brands" at 600. The grid shows the system's preference for ruled tables over floating cards.

### Case Study Tag

**Role:** Inline link chip inside logos

A warm printed chip. It uses a `#fbf3e0` background, `#a87a12` text, no border, 2px radius, 4px 8px padding and 25px height. The label is Saans 12px at 475 with a trailing plus glyph. It is a 2px chip in a pill-button system, a deliberate outlier: it signals that it is metadata, not an action competing with the CTAs.

### Feature Column — Hairline Rule (Main Content Card)

**Role:** Three-up value proposition

Cards without cards. It has no background, a 1px `#e5e8e8` left border, 0px radius, 0px 24px padding and no shadow. A 16px `#a87a12` line icon sits 24px above an H3 in Saans 16px at 600 `#00262b`, followed by Saans 16px at 475 description in `#4d6164` at 364px width. A single vertical rule replaces the conventional bordered, rounded and shadowed feature card, and it reads as a report column.

### Capability Photo Tile — Spruce Scrim

**Role:** Product area entry points

A teal-tinted photo strip. It has five equal 0px-radius tiles across the 1680px bleed, 333px tall, with documentary team photography under a `#0b363bcc` scrim and 1px `#0b363b` seams between tiles. A 32px circular plus button in translucent spruce sits 16px from the top-left. The white label is Saans 20px at 600, 16px from the bottom. The scrim unifies mismatched photos into one brand-colored surface.

### Eyebrow Label

**Role:** Section kicker above H2s

A gold tab and a word. An 12×8px `#a87a12` tag glyph sits 8px left of Saans 14px at 475 `#00262b` text ("AI Agent", "Capabilities"), placed 8px above a 40px H2. Ochre here is the most saturated thing in each section opener and is still smaller than a lowercase letter.

### Arrow Text Link

**Role:** Tertiary navigation to deeper pages

A bare directional link. It has no background, border or padding: a 12px arrow followed 6px later by Saans 14px at 600 in `#00262b`. It is used for "Platform overview" and "Meet your Agent", right-aligned against H2s or 24px below paragraphs, and keeps secondary routes out of the pill vocabulary.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline from 24px to 96px at weight 475 — the restrained weight is the signature, and size does the hierarchy work.
- Keep tracking at 0.2px across all sizes, including 96px display — flat tracking preserves the editorial calm that negative tracking would turn into ad copy.
- Use `#00262b` for all primary text and `#0b363b` for all dark fills — the teal-black keeps brand hue inside every glyph without adding a color.
- Shape every button as a 9999px pill with a 2px border and 8px 20px padding — the capsule is reserved for actions, so it is instantly recognizable.
- Separate content with 1px `#e5e8e8` hairlines at 0px radius — ruled columns and cells replace cards and keep the grid architectural.
- Ration `#b6f2a3` to the single 4px ring around the primary CTA — one glow per viewport is non-negotiable, because it is the page's only wayfinding beacon.
- Space sections 128px apart inside a 1320px container — the generous gap lets 40px headings breathe at a weight that does not shout.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 700 for "impact" — weight 700 appears on 3 elements total, and pushing H1s or H2s there destroys the single-weight thesis that defines the system.
- Don't apply -2% tracking to the 96px display — tightening is the conventional move, and here it erases the deliberate text-like spacing of the headline.
- Don't use `#000000` or neutral grays like `#333333` for text — they break the teal undertone carried by `#00262b` and `#4d6164`.
- Don't wrap features in rounded 12px cards with drop shadows — the system uses 0px radius and 1px `#e5e8e8` rules, and floating cards turn the report into a dashboard.
- Don't fill buttons or banners with `#b6f2a3` or `#3f9a4a` — green exists only as a 4px ring and as status glyphs, and a green fill steals the CTA's meaning.
- Don't round tags to 9999px — the 2px tag radius distinguishes metadata from actions, and pill tags read as clickable buttons.
- Never color running text with the six decorative statement hues — that treatment is a one-sentence editorial exception, and repeating it collapses the three-hue budget.

## Elevation

- **Primary CTA halo (nav and hero "Get started"):** `0px 0px 0px 4px #b6f2a3`
- **Secondary CTA halo ("Book a demo"):** `0px 0px 0px 4px #f5f5f5`
- **Cards, columns, tiles, screenshots, nav:** `none`

## Imagery

The page mixes three image types with strict roles. Product screenshots show the real Customer.io UI: reports, a journey chart, an agent panel. They are composited over warm documentary interior photography with a 6px top-only radius, no border and no shadow, and bleed off the bottom edge. Team photography appears only inside capability tiles, flattened by a `#0b363bcc` scrim into a single teal field. A textured off-white paper photo backs the AI Agent mockup. Icons are 16px single-stroke line glyphs in `#a87a12`, with no fills or containers. Gradients, glows and orbs are absent. The six-hue coloring of nouns in the statement paragraph is decorative only and not a system token. The narrative: real people, real software, printed on calm paper.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1320px container with 32px gutters (1256px live width), and the capability tile row bleeds to 1680px. Sections are separated by 128px (96–160px observed) on a continuous white canvas, with no alternating bands except the 1px-ruled logo grid and the teal photo strip. The hero is left-aligned: 96px display, 20px subline, pill pair and trust row, followed by a full-width product stage. Feature rows run 3 columns divided by hairlines, the logo grid runs 4 columns by 2 rows, and the capability strip runs 5 tiles. Split sections pair a left text column with a right mockup at roughly 1:1. The nav is sticky, white, 64px tall and hairline-ruled, with logo left, menu centered and actions right. The footer is a full-width 64px-padded link directory. At 375px, set the H1 at 40px and use 64px section gaps. Density: spacious.

**Color in Data**

**Example Component Prompts**

2. Hero Section: on `#ffffff`, inside a 1320px container with 32px side padding and 96px top padding, left-align an H1 in Saans 96px, weight 475, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 0.2px, color `#00262b`, over two lines. Add 32px gap, then a 20px weight 475 subline at line-height 1.375 in `#00262b`, max-width 500px. Add 32px gap, then the primary and secondary pills from prompt 1. Add 16px gap, then a row of three trust items, each a `#3f9a4a` 10px check icon plus 10px weight 500 text in `#7a898b`, spaced 12px apart. Below, after 64px, place a 1256px-wide product screenshot with 6px top-left and top-right radius, no shadow.

3. Navigation Bar: create a sticky header 64px tall with background `#ffffff`, a 1px solid `#e5e8e8` bottom border and 0px radius, inside a 1680px max-width with 64px side padding. Put the wordmark (152px wide, `#0b363b`) left. Center four menu buttons (Platform, Solutions, Resources with 12px chevrons, Pricing) in Saans 16px weight 600, normal letter-spacing, `#00262b`, padding 0 8px 0 16px, full 64px height. On the right place a "Sign in" text link at 14px weight 600 with 8px padding, then the primary and secondary 40px pills 8px apart. Above it add a 32px `#0b363b` announcement bar with centered 14px weight 475 `#ffffff` text.

4. Feature Column Row: in a 1256px container, lay out three equal columns with no background, each with a 1px solid `#e5e8e8` left border, 0px radius and padding 0 24px. No shadows, no card fills.

5. Capability Photo Tiles: build a 1680px-wide row of five equal tiles, 333px tall, 0px radius, separated by 1px `#0b363b` seams. Each tile holds a cover-fit team photograph under an overlay of `#0b363bcc`. Place a 32px circular button 16px from the top and left edges with a `#0b363bcc` fill and a 16px `#ffffff` plus glyph. Set the label 16px from the bottom and left in Saans 20px weight 600, line-height 1.125, `#ffffff`.

## Single-Weight Discipline

The whole voice rests on weight 475 doing almost everything. It covers 125 of 180 sampled elements, from 12px captions to the 96px headline, with 600 reserved for nav, H3s and buttons. Hierarchy is carried entirely by size on a Major Third ladder plus two display leaps (40 → 64 → 96). The discipline breaks the moment anyone reaches for 700 to rescue a weak heading, tightens display tracking below 0.2px, or introduces a second display face. To extend it, add a size, not a weight. A new 48px heading role or a 30px pull-quote both fit the ratio. A new emphasis should use 600 at text sizes, and color for emphasis stays limited to `#00262b` versus `#4d6164`.

## Hairline Geometry

Structure comes from 1px `#e5e8e8` rules and 0px corners, not from containers. Logo cells, feature columns, the nav edge and tile seams are all lines. The only curves in the system are the 9999px action pills, the 6px top corners on screenshots and the 2px chips. That contrast is the point: anything round is clickable or is product, and everything else is print. The geometry breaks if features are boxed in 12px-radius shadowed cards, if pills appear as tags, or if a second ring color joins `#b6f2a3`. New modules, such as a pricing table, should use ruled columns on `#ffffff`, a `#f5f5f5` header strip, and pill CTAs as the sole rounded elements.

- **Customer.io** — shares Intercom's habit of a single custom grotesk and near-black ink carrying the entire marketing page, though Intercom spends its budget on a bright orange where Customer.io holds teal.
- **Customer.io** — shares Attio's 1px-ruled grid cells and pill CTAs on a white canvas, with Customer.io warmer through ochre micro-markers.
- **Customer.io** — shares Klaviyo's category positioning and documentary photography of marketers at work, but replaces Klaviyo's charcoal-and-cream contrast with a teal-scrim treatment.
